verses.en: Praise ye the LORD. Sing unto the LORD a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.
verses.sm: Ia outou vivii atu ì le ALII. Ia outou pepese i le ALII i le pese fou; pepese i lona viiga i le faapotopotoga a ona tagata amio Atua.

verses.en: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
verses.sm: Ia fiafia Isaraelu i le na faia i latou; ia olioli le fanau a Siona í lo latou Tupu.

verses.en: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.
verses.sm: Ia latou vivii atu i lona suafa ma le siva, ia latou fai pesega ia te ia i le topa ma le kitara.

verses.en: For the LORD taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.
verses.sm: Auā o loo fiafia le ALII i lona nuu; e faamatagofie e ia i le olataga e ua agamalu.

verses.en: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.
verses.sm: Ia olioli i le mamalu e ua amio Atua; ia latou alalaga fiafia i o latou moega;

verses.en: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;
verses.sm: ia i ai i o latou gutu O faaneeneega i le Atua; ia i ai foi i o latou lima le pelu e faatau maai itu;

verses.en: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;
verses.sm: ina ia faia le taui ma sui i nuu ese, o le aoaiga i nuu; ina ia noanoatia o latou tupu i maea uamea,

verses.en: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;
verses.sm: ma o latou alii mamalu i noataga uamea;

verses.en: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.sm: ina ia faia ia i latou o le faamasinoga ua tusia. Ua i ona tagata amio Atua uma lava lena mamalu. Ia outou vivii atu i le ALII.
